edits.after:
if(NODE_CRYPTO_AUDITED_BORROW AND NOT NODE_COMPAT_CRYPTO_HASH_HMAC)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_CRYPTO_AUDITED_BORROW requires NODE_COMPAT_CRYPTO_HASH_HMAC")
endif()

# Experimental finite import-only surfaces. No new host capabilities.
option(NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_IMPORTS "Enable finite Next tty/inspector/v8/dns-promises imports" OFF)
if(NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_IMPORTS AND NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    if(NOT TARGET builtin_node_compat)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_IMPORTS requires ENABLE_BUILTIN_NODE_COMPAT=ON")
    endif()
    target_sources(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE builtins/node-compat/next-imports/next-imports.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_IMPORTS=1)
endif()

# Node-shaped HTTP messages over the selected standard WASI guest entry.
option(NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_HTTP "Enable experimental Next HTTP message/hosting bindings" OFF)
if(NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_HTTP AND NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    if(NOT TARGET builtin_node_compat)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_HTTP requires ENABLE_BUILTIN_NODE_COMPAT=ON")
    endif()
    foreach(NEXT_HTTP_PREREQUISITE ASYNC_LOCAL_STORAGE CLASSIC_STREAMS NEXT_STARTUP MODULE INTERNAL_TICKS)
        if(NOT NODE_COMPAT_${NEXT_HTTP_PREREQUISITE})
            message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_HTTP requires NODE_COMPAT_${NEXT_HTTP_PREREQUISITE}=ON")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    # Bridge constructors/finish use these actual globals, including clearTimeout.
    foreach(NEXT_HTTP_WEB fetch streams url timers)
        if(NOT TARGET builtin_web_${NEXT_HTTP_WEB})
            message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_HTTP requires existing builtin_web_${NEXT_HTTP_WEB}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    target_sources(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE builtins/node-compat/next-http/next-http.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE NODE_COMPAT_NEXT_HTTP=1)
    target_include_directories(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime")
    add_dependencies(builtin_node_compat builtin_web_fetch builtin_web_streams builtin_web_url builtin_web_timers)
    target_link_libraries(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE builtin_web_fetch builtin_web_streams builtin_web_url builtin_web_timers)
endif()
